focus.jnote: The backdrop turned hostile again overnight. President Trump rejected Iran's conditional offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz — Tehran had said the strait could reopen in seven days if the U.S. lifted its naval blockade and eased economic warfare — and reportedly told aides he expects strikes to resume after November's midterms. WTI rose ~2% back above $94 and Brent climbed above $106 (its highest in about two weeks). The 10-year yield sits near ~5.21%, a 2007-era high, after hawkish Fed comments and a University of Michigan survey showing rising inflation expectations; markets price ~66–70% odds of an October hike. Gold fell below $4,200 to ~$4,150, a seven-week low, as higher yields and a firm dollar pressured it. This is a live, open-ended war-plus-rate-shock tape — not one a Sniper sells premium into.
focus.notdown: Energy (XLE, XOM, CVX, OXY) is the one group catching a bid as the rejected Hormuz deal and blockade risk lift crude. But be honest: this is a two-sided war trade, not a clean Sniper — one credible de-escalation or ceasefire headline and crude gives back several dollars in minutes, gapping any bull put the wrong way. Note the scanner examined the full universe and boarded nothing here. Watch-only, not a table-pounder.
focus.notup: Rate-sensitive growth & long-duration tech stay the pressure point as the 10Y pushes to 2007 highs and October-hike odds sit near 70%. But selling bear calls into a rising-VIX, headline-driven war tape carries violent squeeze risk on any peace or de-escalation headline — the disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today. The scanner confirms it: zero bearish names cleared confirmation.
focus.why: Why RED? Composite ~64 is deep in WARM and P(≥1% gap) at 40% is above the 35% trigger — either alone locks out GREEN. More important than the numbers: a rejected Hormuz deal with an oil pop plus a bond sell-off to 2007-high yields is an open-ended, two-headed macro shock that can gap the whole tape on the next headline, auction or Fed comment. And decisively, the full-universe scanner boarded ZERO names — there is simply nothing that survived to a confirmed gap or breakout today. Stand down on new credit spreads, or push DTE past the yield/war window and cut size hard. Cash is a position today.
